plans.title: Career plans
plans.intro: Career plans are optional add-ons with their own credits, used only by the career tools. This is what each plan includes.
plans.infoOnly: This screen is for information only. Nothing can be bought or changed here.
plans.currentNone: You don't have a career plan.
plans.fixture: Local test entitlement, not a real purchase

features.projectBriefInSkillReport: Project brief inside a skill report

delivery.immediateOptional: Optional immediate email, push and Telegram

plans.pooledNote: On Business, CV versions, tracked applications, evidence items and portfolio pages are per candidate. Other Business usage is pooled.
plans.annualNote: Billed once a year. Allowances still renew every month.
plans.creditsNote: Career credits are separate from your FlacronCV AI credits and are used only by the career tools.
plans.renewalNote: Included units renew every month on your billing date and do not roll over. Editing, reopening saved results and downloads use no credits. A failed generation returns its credit.

erase.title: Erase career data
erase.body: Permanently removes your career records and uploaded evidence files. Your FlacronCV account, CVs, cover letters, job tracker and subscription stay as they are. To close your whole account, use Settings.
erase.erased: Your career data has been erased.
erase.nothing: There is no career data to erase.
erase.signInAgain: For your security, sign out and sign in again, then erase within five minutes.
erase.failed: Career data could not be erased completely. Nothing else was changed. Try again.
erase.dialogBody: This cannot be undone. Your FlacronCV account, CVs, cover letters and Job Tracker stay as they are.
erase.closeAccountBody: Deleting your account in Settings › Your data also erases all career data.

copy.title: Use a draft in your CVs or cover letters
copy.body: Copies the draft into a new CV or cover letter that you then edit, style and export as usual. Your plan's limits apply. The draft itself is not changed.
copy.copiedCv: New CV created from your draft.
copy.copiedLetter: New cover letter created from your draft.
copy.failed: The draft could not be copied.
copy.noVersion: This draft has no content yet.
copy.saveFirst: Save your changes first. The copy is made from the saved draft.
copy.partial: The new document was created but not completely filled. Copy again to finish it; no second document is made.
